sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully encodes the declared Table 8 lookup, linked case structure, required operands, controlled values, evidence, units, and not-less-than grade-rank comparison.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Make the table lookup inseparable from each steel-grade requirement case: constrain nltl:hasSteelGradeRequirementCase and nltl:hasTableLookupCase to the same value set (for example sh:equals) and apply the TableLookupCaseShape to those same case nodes. The current two optional, independent paths allow an arbitrary required grade to be compared without a linked Table 8 lookup. Add sh:minCount 1 to nltl:lookupSelectionEvidence within TableLookupCaseShape so every selected lookup case has the required selection evidence. Do not add a ship-level minimum case cardinality solely from this universal plating rule.

Complete the declared dependency contract: add the missing applicability selector nltl:materialClass on its authoritative owner nltl:ship with sh:minCount 1 and xsd:string, and add the missing operand nltl:asBuiltThickness on nltl:ship as a qudt:QuantityValue with decimal numeric value and its canonical unit unit:M. Retain the case-owned nltl:asBuiltPlateThickness in unit:MilliM; it is a separately declared required operand/result and must not be relocated.
Candidate faithfully encodes the declared Table 8 lookup, linked case structure, required operands, controlled values, evidence, units, and not-less-than grade-rank comparison.
